iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 62. RISING: Enrichment talks stalled - US demands 20-year suspension, Iran proposes 5-year. Iran nuclear chief rules out any restrictions on enrichment. IAEA still locked out of bombed facilities 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown - half possibly at Isfahan, rest dispersed. NPT Review Conference starts Apr 27 in Vienna - shaping as battleground. IAEA Grossi urges strict checks in any future deal. Bushehr near-strike confirmed by IAEA. Trump: 'unacceptable' for Iran to have bomb. China blocked UNSC resolution. CSIS: stockpiles sufficient for 10 weapons in 3 weeks. Probability 40%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 62. BLOCKADE DAY 6: US blockade fully implemented on Iranian ports. US general clarifies blockade targets Iranian ports, not full Strait. 13+ ships turned away. Qatar hosting diplomatic talks - Pakistan PM Sharif in Doha. France/UK to chair post-war Hormuz conference. Trump says war 'very close to over.' 2nd round US-Iran talks under discussion. Iran threatens Red Sea/Gulf shipping retaliation. Oil Brent ~$102. Ceasefire deadline Apr 22 - 5 days away. Diplomatic window narrowing. China FM: Hormuz reopening 'international demand.' Senate Republicans block Democratic effort to end war. Probability 58%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 62. BREAKING: Trump announces 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon. Netanyahu confirmed agreement. Lebanon PM Nawaf Salam welcomes ceasefire. Rubio hosted first high-level meeting in DC. However: Hezbollah NOT part of agreement - demands no freedom of movement for Israeli forces during ceasefire. Netanyahu says Israeli troops will remain in Lebanon. Hezbollah claims right to resist. Displaced Lebanese wary of ceasefire holding. 4 paramedics killed in Lebanon before ceasefire. UN experts condemn Israel's unprecedented bombing. 1M+ displaced. Canada/UK/Australia call for end to hostilities. Ceasefire fragile - Hezbollah rejected direct negotiations. Probability 22%. Falling.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened new production facilities Apr 7 - warhead, missile integration, fuel plants. Largest defense investment in Republic history ($3B). TAYFUN Block 4 hypersonic entering serial production 2026. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned. Defense spending up 30% to $27.34B. Pushing EU defense integration. Probability 5%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR 2026 survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely - Tier II risk. Drivers intact - terrorism from Pakistan. 2025 Operation Sindoor precedent. Pakistan PM Sharif in Qatar mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. No new escalations past 24h. Probability 6%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 66. RISING: First of 64 Finnish F-35A fighter jets capable of carrying nuclear weapons arriving 2026. Finnish nuclear weapons vote still pending in parliament. Kremlin warns Finland 'will pose threat, force countermeasures.' Medvedev: Finland/Sweden 'automatic targets.' Finnish professor warns Finland could be first hit in NATO-Russia war. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war vs neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Russia war windfall from Iran conflict oil revenues. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 16%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: Taiwan tracking 3 PLA aircraft + 9 ships as of Apr 16. Naval surge beyond typical 50-60 ships continues - 'very rare' per officials. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun - 'absolutely not tolerate' independence. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite US blockade. NSB director: China testing US aircraft frequency. $14B US arms for Taiwan. ISW/AEI weekly updates. Taiwan launches military drills to secure energy routes. PLA Type 055 destroyers live-fire drill. Probability 36%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 62. SUSTAINED: Kim oversaw 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer (Apr 12) - 2 cruise + 3 anti-ship missiles. Third destroyer test round in 6 weeks. Kim pledges navy operational capability boost. 4th destroyer under construction. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. KCNA photos show Kim observing tests. Probability 10%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1166+. RISING: Russia launched deadliest aerial attack of 2026 on Apr 16 - 17 killed, 100+ wounded across Ukraine. Extensive ballistic missile use. Kyiv hit - 4 killed including 12-year-old. Zelenskyy scrambled to Germany/Norway/Italy for more Patriot systems. Ukraine drone attack on Russian port Tuapse killed 2 including 14-year-old. ISW daily assessments continue. Patriot shortage critical as systems diverted to Iran theater. IISS: 'escalation, not stalemate.' Russia intensifying sabotage in Europe. Russia crude exports from Black Sea port limited. Russia warns Europe over drone production. Probability 85%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi concluded 2nd round - agreed not to escalate, explore comprehensive solution. Fighting worst since Taliban 2021. Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed. Pakistan operations against TTP continue. PM Sharif in Qatar for regional diplomacy. Lowy Institute: 'the other war the world is ignoring.' Probability 7%. Stable.
